title: Dual Chidori
body:
Syntax: perform dual chidori <target>

Description: A stronger two-handed Chidori that can paralyze.  Requires Lightning chakra nature. Base damage: 203-235. 20% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
